# =============================================================================
#  FEP-VID006-MIPI + 2x IMX415  引脚约束 (Anlogic TD .adc)
#  板卡 MLK-F9P-CA05-PH1P100 / PH1P100SBG484 / -3
#  FEP 口在 BANK13（HR-ADJ），子卡是 1.8V 器件 —— 上电前必须把 BANK13 跳线改到 1.8V
#
#  [已验证] MIPI 差分球号来自 03_管脚定义表/FEP-管脚定义表.xlsx（与底板原理图 P17_FEP 同源）
#  [待核对] 控制线（I2C/MCLK/XCLR）球号：子卡原理图 PDF 多列文本重建时对不齐，
#           请照图纸确认后填 LOCATION（这几根是 1.8V 信号，填错可能打到 5V 脚）
# =============================================================================

# ---------------- 系统时钟 / LED（球号来自 03_管脚定义表/CLK、按钮-LED 表）----------------
set_pin_assignment { sys_clk50m } { LOCATION = H4;  IOSTANDARD = SSTL135; PULLTYPE = PULLUP; }   # FPGA_50M_CLK, 1.35V
set_pin_assignment { O_led[0]   } { LOCATION = E21; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS33; }
set_pin_assignment { O_led[1]   } { LOCATION = D21; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS33; }
set_pin_assignment { O_led[2]   } { LOCATION = E22; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS33; }
set_pin_assignment { O_led[3]   } { LOCATION = D22; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS33; }

# ---------------- MIPI-A（子卡 U5，4 lane + 1 clk）----------------
# 走底板 FEP1B 的 C 排（子卡侧 MIPIA_FLANE*/MIPIA_CSI_FCLK*）。实测：A 排那侧子卡上串了 100R，
# 1.5Gbps 下只收到 ~12% 的包；换 C 排（0R 直连）后 B 口从 0.6k 包/s 提到 70k 包/s —— A 口同理。
# 另外 K18/K19、J19/H19 都是时钟可用脚（TD 的 GCLK=Y），顺手解决了 PHY-5019 警告。
set_pin_assignment { mipi_a_clk_hs_p     } { LOCATION = K18; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C15 (B15)
set_pin_assignment { mipi_a_clk_hs_n     } { LOCATION = K19; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C16 (B16)
set_pin_assignment { mipi_a_data_hs_p[0] } { LOCATION = N20; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C6  (B6)
set_pin_assignment { mipi_a_data_hs_n[0] } { LOCATION = M20; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C7  (B7)
set_pin_assignment { mipi_a_data_hs_p[1] } { LOCATION = K21; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C13 (B13)
set_pin_assignment { mipi_a_data_hs_n[1] } { LOCATION = K22; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C14 (B14)
set_pin_assignment { mipi_a_data_hs_p[2] } { LOCATION = N18; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C8  (B8)
set_pin_assignment { mipi_a_data_hs_n[2] } { LOCATION = N19; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C9  (B9)
set_pin_assignment { mipi_a_data_hs_p[3] } { LOCATION = M21; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C10 (B10)
set_pin_assignment { mipi_a_data_hs_n[3] } { LOCATION = L21; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C11 (B11)

# ---------------- MIPI-B（子卡 U6，4 lane + 1 clk）----------------
# 用底板 FEP1B 的 C 排引脚（子卡侧对应 MIPIB_FLANE*/MIPIB_CSI_FCLK*）：
#   子卡 C17/C18=C29? 否 —— C17/C18 等经 C(n)=B(n) 换算到球号
#   子卡 A17/A18=PLB_CSI_CLK，C17/C18=MIPIB_CSI_FCLK（同一对 lane，走另一个连接器）
# 原因：子卡上 B 口的 0R 直连在 C 排那一侧（A 排那侧串了 100R，1.5Gbps 衰减太厉害，
#       表现就是"每条 lane 都能找到同步头、但组装成包就错"）。
set_pin_assignment { mipi_b_clk_hs_p     } { LOCATION = J19; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C17
set_pin_assignment { mipi_b_clk_hs_n     } { LOCATION = H19; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C18
set_pin_assignment { mipi_b_data_hs_p[0] } { LOCATION = J22; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C26
set_pin_assignment { mipi_b_data_hs_n[0] } { LOCATION = H22; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C27
set_pin_assignment { mipi_b_data_hs_p[1] } { LOCATION = G17; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C24
set_pin_assignment { mipi_b_data_hs_n[1] } { LOCATION = G18; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C25
set_pin_assignment { mipi_b_data_hs_p[2] } { LOCATION = J20; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C22
set_pin_assignment { mipi_b_data_hs_n[2] } { LOCATION = J21; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C23
set_pin_assignment { mipi_b_data_hs_p[3] } { LOCATION = L19; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C19
set_pin_assignment { mipi_b_data_hs_n[3] } { LOCATION = L20; IOSTANDARD = LVDS18; PULLTYPE = NONE; }   # C20

# ---------------- 传感器控制（1V8，球号已核对）----------------
# 子卡侧引脚 → 底板球号：
#   A 口：FGPIO(A4)=M18  FCLK/MCLK(A5)=L18  FSCL(C4)=N22  FSDA(C5)=M22
#   B 口：FSCL(A28)=H13  FSDA(A29)=G13      FGPIO(C28)=H20 FCLK/MCLK(C29)=G20
# 两条已实测确认的规律：
#  (1) 底板 FEP1B 的 C 排与 FEP1A 的 B 排同网：C(n)=B(n)
#      （用户实测 C4=N22=B4、C27=H22=B27、C28=H20=B28、C3=GND=B3）
#  (2) 子卡原理图 C/D 排的**网络名比引脚号错开一行**：标在 C(n) 旁边的网络名实际接在 C(n+1)。
#      反证：MIPIA_FSCL 若真在 C3（=GND）则 A 口 I2C 必然 NACK，而实测 A 口 errA=0 且正常出图，
#      说明它实际在 C4(N22) —— 即本文件用的 C4/C5 是对的；同理 B 口要往上一格取 C28/C29。
set_pin_assignment { cam_a_xclr_n } { LOCATION = M18; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS18; DRIVESTRENGTH = 8; }
set_pin_assignment { cam_a_mclk   } { LOCATION = L18; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS18; DRIVESTRENGTH = 8; }
set_pin_assignment { cam_a_scl    } { LOCATION = N22; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS18; PULLTYPE = PULLUP; DRIVESTRENGTH = 8; }
set_pin_assignment { cam_a_sda    } { LOCATION = M22; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS18; PULLTYPE = PULLUP; DRIVESTRENGTH = 8; }
set_pin_assignment { cam_b_scl    } { LOCATION = H13; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS18; PULLTYPE = PULLUP; DRIVESTRENGTH = 8; }
set_pin_assignment { cam_b_sda    } { LOCATION = G13; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS18; PULLTYPE = PULLUP; DRIVESTRENGTH = 8; }
set_pin_assignment { cam_b_xclr_n } { LOCATION = H20; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS18; DRIVESTRENGTH = 8; }
set_pin_assignment { cam_b_mclk   } { LOCATION = G20; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS18; DRIVESTRENGTH = 8; }

# ---------------- 调试串口（115200 状态输出）----------------
# FPGA_UART_TX0 = R17（已用原理图坐标逐行核对：R17=TX0、P16=RX0，管脚表一致）
set_pin_assignment { O_uart_txd  } { LOCATION = R17; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS33; DRIVESTRENGTH = 8; }

# ---------------- HDMI 输出（HDMI-OUT-管脚定义表：FD0=B15 FD1=B21 FD2=C22 FCLK=C18，3V3）----------------
# 输出差分只约束 P 端（IOSTANDARD=LVDS33_E，N 端由工具配对；与米联客 25_rgb2hdmi_out 例程一致）
set_pin_assignment { O_hdmi_tx_p[0] } { LOCATION = B15; IOSTANDARD = LVDS33_E; }
set_pin_assignment { O_hdmi_tx_p[1] } { LOCATION = B21; IOSTANDARD = LVDS33_E; }
set_pin_assignment { O_hdmi_tx_p[2] } { LOCATION = C22; IOSTANDARD = LVDS33_E; }
set_pin_assignment { O_hdmi_clk_p   } { LOCATION = C18; IOSTANDARD = LVDS33_E; }

 set_pin_assignment { sys_rst_n  } { LOCATION = R14 ; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS33; PULLTYPE = PULLUP;}
set_pin_assignment { usr_uart_rxd } { LOCATION = P16; IOSTANDARD = LVCMOS33;PULLTYPE = PULLUP;}
